notes: Tagged repository baseline euro-2028-baseline remains contract 63. Contracts 64–100 establish the multi-competition season foundations, domestic game engines, Cup-neutral sources, provider custody and the two tournament-path corrections. Contract 101 removes obsolete shared-league gating from Euro post-lock reveal without widening pre-lock access. Contract 102 persists the Predictor Championship split as a distinct phase. Contract 103 reconciles game availability with repeatable competition instances: one live public row per season game, one live row per independent series, public/private coexistence, scoped predecessor lineage and bounded completion reasons. Contract 104 keeps five operational callers live-only and moves five read surfaces onto a current-public resolver that prefers live and otherwise retains the latest terminal result; Contract 102 Cup phase filters remain intact. Contract 105 enforces one-parent split ancestry and derives the continuing Championship table from settled initial and split fixtures without copying a starting total. Contract 107 is the Last Man Standing restart itself: it completes a wiped-out competition as no_winner_restarted, creates one linked successor, re-enters every entrant and copies no selections, cycles, projections or windows. Contract 108 guards the gap that deferral leaves — a successor may not hold a round that opened or locked before its predecessor finished, so the catalogue publisher cannot give a fresh competition rounds nobody could play in. Contract 109 closes the deferral itself: the next eligible league round is derived from the existing matchweek lock authority, the successor's calendar is generated from it exactly once, and an hourly job drives the restart from what settlement reported. Settlement continues only to derive and report. Contract 110 gives the season Predictor Championship rounds it can be played over: until it, nothing in the repository created a window for a season competition while bonus_cup_fixtures.window_id is NOT NULL, so no season Championship fixture could be persisted in either phase. It schedules N rounds from the next eligible league matchweeks, refuses a season that cannot supply the whole format rather than truncating it, and appends rather than owning the calendar so the split phase can be scheduled on the same competition later. Contract 111 launches a season Championship: threshold, format, initial group, draw, rounds and round-robin fixtures. It drives the single-group shape and refuses the multi-group one by name. The public threshold applies only to public competitions — a hundred-entrant field always takes the multi-group shape, so the shape this drives belongs to organiser-created private competitions. Hosted deployment remains separately guarded and is not claimed by this repository contract. Contract 113 gives the season matchweek card its bounded browser path: one read and three writes scoped to the caller's own entry, with locks, the Joker allowance and version conflicts enforced by the triggers that already own them, a version column and PT409 trigger on season_predictions, and the delete path brought under the matchweek lock so clearing a prediction or taking back a Joker after lock refuses. No table grant is added and no rule moves.
